compatibility.instructions: Could the starter-synthesis module, its test file, or the CI lens-list addition regress any existing lens contract, export surface, kit path firewall, or CI job?

correctness.instructions: Any missing synthesis header, wrong fixed file set, unescaped tag, copied site text, wrong truncation accounting, unpinned dependency, or test/implementation mismatch?

evidence.instructions: Are the 8 unit tests sufficient for fixed set plus headers, no-copy proof, escaping, pinned deps, honesty notes, empty stub, determinism, and malformed requests?

reliability.instructions: Any nondeterministic byte, unhandled section shape, or unbounded input across equivalent requests?

scope.instructions: Anything beyond placeholder starter synthesis: theme generation, token extraction, network, storage, job lifecycle, or public API?

security.instructions: Any stored XSS via section tags, site-content laundering into redistributable starter files, path traversal in starter paths, or secret material in the module or tests?
